## The Hartford’s Chief Financial Officer To Speak At The 2026 KBW Insurance Conference On Sept. 10


September 03, 2026


[Download PDF (opens in new window) PDF](https://s206.q4cdn.com/854710405/files/doc_news/2026/Sep/03/09032026-KBW-Conference-Final.pdf)


HARTFORD, Conn., Sept. 3, 2026 – The Hartford’s Chief Financial Officer Beth Costello will participate in a fireside chat at the 2026 KBW Insurance Conference at approximately 8:20 a.m. on Thursday, Sept. 10.


A webcast of the event will be made available, along with a replay, for at least 90 days following the event at[https://ir.thehartford.com](https://ir.thehartford.com/) .


**About The Hartford**


The Hartford is a leader in property and casualty insurance and employee benefits. By anticipating challenges and reducing risks our customers face, the company helps people and businesses thrive with confidence. Built on a foundation of trust, The Hartford is committed to strong performance, exceptional customer experiences and bold innovation, hallmarks of its sustained success since 1810.


The Hartford Insurance Group, Inc., (NYSE: HIG) operates through its subsidiaries under the brand name, The Hartford, and is headquartered in Hartford, Connecticut. More information on the company and its financial performance is available on its[website.](https://www.thehartford.com/) For additional details, please read[The Hartford’s legal notice](https://www.thehartford.com/legal-notice) .
